WARNING TO USERS OF THIS SYSTEM

This computer system, including all related equipment, networks, and network devices (including Internet access), is provided by the Department of the Interior (DOI) in accordance with the agency policy for official use and limited personal use. All agency computer systems may be monitored for all lawful purposes, including but not limited to, ensuring that use is authorized, for management of the system, to facilitate protection against unauthorized access, and to verify security procedures, survivability and operational security. Any information on this computer system may be examined, recorded, copied and used for authorized purposes at any time. All information, including personal information, placed or sent over this system may be monitored, and users of this system are reminded that such monitoring does occur. Therefore, there should be no expectation of privacy with respect to use of this system. By logging into this agency computer system, you acknowledge and consent to the monitoring of this system. Evidence of your use, authorized or unauthorized, collected during monitoring may be used for civil, criminal, administrative, or other adverse action. Unauthorized or illegal use may subject you to prosecution.

Multi-factor Authentication - Passkey

EROS Registration System (ERS) now offers an option of accessing accounts using a Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) passkey as an added security feature. The option allows users to login into ERS and associated websites; EarthExplorer, GloVis, HDDS, etc. via cell phones, tablets, etc. that store the passkey. Users now have the option of using either the traditional registered Username/Password or the new Passkey option.

Quick Start Guide
First Time Setup
  • First time setting a Passkey and for users that already have a registered Username/Password, enter your username/password information into the Sign In page and click on the “Sign in with USGS Password” button.
  • Within the ERS user profile page, Click the dropdown with “Authentication Options”.
  • Click “Add Authenticator”.
  • At Register an Authenticator, enter a name for the authenticator, i.e. Mobile, Tablet, iPAD etc. Click “Continue”.
  • Choose device to save your passkey. Click on “iPhone, iPad, or Android Device” option and then click “Next”. As more devices are made available, they will be added to the list.
  • Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on the device to save passkey. Click “Next”.
  • Scan QR code and follow instructions on your device and the website popups.
  • You will receive an email confirming the saved passkey.
Follow On ERS Passkey Login
  • Users that already have a registered ERS account and a saved passkey can enter their registered “username” and click “Sign in with a passkey”. Note: a password will not need to be entered.
  • The list of devices will display. Depending on the device you registered with, select “iPhone, iPad, or Android” choice or the device, if listed.
  • Scan the QR code or check your device for a connection notification.
  • Follow the steps on the device.
  • Once completed you will be logged in.

(Detailed instructions at ERS Multi-Factor Passkey Help or access Help in the menu bar.)
